domains.gold_constructor: Enumerate the one actually expressed json/filename claim and the original largest-filename requirement; independently enumerate the complete original cloud-drive table, compute its maximum size and all tied filenames. domains.gold_positive_rule: The original expressed filename equals a filename at the maximum original size, including genuine ties.
domains.gold_negative_rule: A complete valid original file table establishes that the expressed filename is not among its maximum-size filenames.
domains.omission_test: Omit json/filename from every judge vote: its source-derived gold item remains and the missing prediction is unknown/error, never removed from the sampling universe.
